_source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fishing_Trawler and /Strategies (rules, points, rewards); the cache for every id (gameval names below) and the HUD (trawler_overlay scripts 3045-3053). Timings the Wiki does not give are marked _calibrated.

lobby._note: the docked trawler's deck at Port Khazard

boat._note: the dry trawler copy; its leaks are on the lower deck (plane 0)

timing._calibrated: leak, net and kraken cadence; the Wiki gives only 'every 5 ticks' for leaks (Strategies) and 'about every 45 seconds' for the kraken, scaled with the crew

catch._calibrated: per-player base fish per catching tick: about 14 for a solo trip with some downtime, falling with crew size towards the Wiki's 13-15 for full groups at a full meter

messages.boardWait: The trawler will leave in {seconds} seconds.
messages.boardBusy: A trawler is already at sea. You will leave on the next one.
messages.depart: You set sail on the trawler.
messages.leak: <col=ef1020>A leak has sprung in the hull!</col>
messages.noPaste: You need some swamp paste to fill the leak.
messages.filled: You fill the leak with swamp paste.
messages.noBucketWater: There isn't enough water here to bail.
messages.bailed: You bail some water from the ship.
messages.emptied: You empty the bucket over the side.
messages.netFailed: You fail to repair the net in the harsh conditions.
messages.netFine: The net is in good condition.
messages.chopFail: You swing at the tentacle but miss.
messages.chopDrove: The tentacle retreats into the sea.
messages.noAxe: You need an axe to chop the tentacle.
messages.noHammer: You need a hammer to fix the rail.
messages.sunk: The trawler has sunk. Climb onto a barrel to get back to shore.
messages.swim: You climb onto the barrel and drift back to shore.
messages.success: The trawler returns to port. Check the trawler net for your catch.
messages.tooLittle: You didn't help enough to earn a share of the catch.
messages.lowLevel: You need a Fishing level of 15 to receive a share of the catch.
messages.nothingInNet: There is nothing in the net for you.
messages.collected: You collect your catch from the net. It is sent to your bank.
messages.bankFull: Your bank is too full to hold all of your catch. The rest stays in the net.
messages.rewardWaiting: <col=ef1020>You have a catch waiting in the trawler net. It will be thrown back if you sail again.</col>
messages.destroyedReward: Your uncollected catch from the last trip has been thrown back.
messages.angler: You find a piece of the angler's outfit in the net!
